name: NorthstarSupportChatbot
description: A flow that handles customer inquiries for Northstar's online customer support, classifying messages and providing automated responses using mock data.

customer_message.description: The message received from the customer, which is used to classify their inquiry.

order_id.description: The order ID related to the inquiry, if applicable. This is optional.

product_name.description: The name of the product related to the inquiry, if applicable. This is also optional.

category.description: The category assigned to the customer message after classification.

final_reply.description: The final composed reply to be sent back to the customer.

methods.name: classify_question
methods.description: Classifies the incoming customer message into a defined category.

methods.name: route_by_category
methods.description: Routes the inquiry based on the classified category.

methods.name: check_order_id_present
methods.description: Checks if the order ID is present in the inquiry.

methods.name: lookup_order_status
methods.description: Looks up the status of an order based on the provided order ID.

methods.name: save_order_reply
methods.description: Saves the order status reply to the final reply.

methods.name: request_order_id
methods.description: Requests the user to provide their order ID in a friendly manner.

methods.name: save_order_id_missing_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply asking for the order ID to the final reply.

methods.name: lookup_return_policy
methods.description: Looks up the return policy for the customer.

methods.name: save_return_reply
methods.description: Saves the return policy reply to the final reply.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks the stock availability of a requested product.

methods.name: save_stock_reply
methods.description: Saves the stock availability reply to the final reply.

methods.name: flag_for_human_review
methods.description: Flags the inquiry for human review if classified as out of scope.

methods.name: save_escalation_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply indicating the inquiry has been escalated for human review.
